name: resumondo
description: Write, tailor and save resumes and cover letters in your Resumondo account from ChatGPT, laid out in templates that hiring software reads correctly, with a PDF ready to send.

interface.longDescription:
Ask ChatGPT for a resume and get a finished one back: saved to your Resumondo account, laid out in a professionally designed template that hiring software (ATS) reads correctly, with a PDF ready to send. No copying, pasting or formatting.

What you can do:
• Write a new resume from your experience, or from a resume you paste in
• Tailor a saved resume to a job posting, then save it as a new version or update the original
• Write a cover letter for a job from your resume
• Choose a template and an accent color
• Keep editing any document in the Resumondo editor on the web

Connect your Resumondo account once. ChatGPT only reads and saves the resumes and cover letters in that account, and every document it saves comes back with an editor link and a PDF download link.
defaultPrompt: Write my resume from my experience and save it to Resumondo as a PDF
Tailor my latest Resumondo resume to this job posting:
Write a cover letter for this job from my Resumondo resume:

positive.description: Lists the resumes saved in the account
positive.prompt: Which resumes do I have in Resumondo?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the sample resume "Alex Morgan - Senior Product Manager" with its last update and a link to open it in the Resumondo editor.

positive.description: Writes and saves a new resume version from a saved resume
positive.prompt: Using my Senior Product Manager resume, write a one-page version for a Product Lead role at a fintech company and save it as a new resume.
positive.expected_behavior: Saves a new resume in the account and replies with its title, an editor link and a PDF download link. The original resume is unchanged.

positive.description: Edits a saved resume and saves the change
positive.prompt: In my Senior Product Manager resume, rewrite the summary to focus on leading data products, and save the change.
positive.expected_behavior: The saved resume's summary is rewritten; every other section stays the same. Replies with a new PDF download link.

positive.description: Shows the templates and switches the resume to one of them
positive.prompt: Show me the Resumondo templates, then switch my resume to a two-column one in blue.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the template names and descriptions, then saves the resume in a two-column template with a blue accent and replies with a new PDF download link.

positive.description: Writes a cover letter for a job from the saved resume
positive.prompt: Write a cover letter for a Senior Product Manager job at Fabrikam, leading their analytics platform team, using my resume. Save it to Resumondo.
positive.expected_behavior: Saves a cover letter addressed to Fabrikam, based on the resume's experience, and replies with an editor link and a PDF download link.

negative.description: Applying to jobs on other sites isn't supported: ChatGPT should say it can't submit applications, and offer to tailor or save the resume instead
negative.prompt: Submit my resume to this job on LinkedIn for me.

negative.description: There is no tool to delete documents: ChatGPT should say resumes are deleted in the Resumondo account on the website, and not call any Resumondo tool
negative.prompt: Delete all my resumes in Resumondo.

negative.description: Resumondo doesn't search for jobs: ChatGPT should answer without Resumondo tools, or say Resumondo can't do that
negative.prompt: Find product manager jobs in Berlin for me.

publication.release_notes: First release: write, tailor and save resumes and cover letters in your Resumondo account from ChatGPT, with a PDF of each.
